Student Training

Build AI literacy from day one of the student journey

Structured programmes that give students the skills, critical thinking and ethical grounding to use AI responsibly - in their studies today and in their careers tomorrow.

3hrs

Workshop duration

F2F / Online

Delivery method

Asynchronous

Online supporting course

Why student AI training matters now

We give students a clear, structured understanding of how AI works, where it adds genuine value, where it falls short, and how to use it in a way that enhances rather than replaces their own thinking.

Using an HE-specific capability assessment, we work with you to tailor training to work in-hand with your existing provision and services.

Critically, all content is aligned to your institution's academic integrity policy from the outset.

Programme content

  • How AI models work
  • AI and academic integrity
  • Better prompting techniques
  • Evaluating AI-generated content
  • AI for data and presentations
  • AI skills for careers
  • Responsible AI use

Typical outcomes

  • More confident student engagement
  • Fewer AI misuse incidents
  • Stronger AI critical thinking
  • Better research and writing
  • Improved graduate employability
  • Fairer access across cohorts

Our student training courses

All workshops are designed to be hands-on and people-focused, creating a positive and supportive environment for learning. Each workshop is supported by an asynchronous online course, to further embed and extend learning.

As HE specialists, we ensure all of our training is in-line with employers' expectations when it comes to graduate AI capabilities.

Delivery options

Programmes can be embedded into existing induction, skills development or module delivery - or run as standalone initiatives. We work with student unions, careers services, library and IT teams to ensure a joined-up approach.
